data.narrative:
Quandela is a Series B quantum computing company founded by Valerian Giesz, Pascale Senellart, and Niccolo Somaschi, backed by the PROQCIMA program. The quantum computing sector comprises 11 known comparable companies: 3 public (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion.

Traditional peer-median valuation is not applicable here. The quantum computing universe lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation tiers—the analysis identified zero qualifying narrow-filter datapoints, falling short of the minimum three-company threshold required for reliable peer-median extrapolation. Broader sector median methodology would introduce substantial distortion given the wide dispersion in quantum computing valuations across different technology modalities and stages.

Without triangulation, this analysis cannot support a specific valuation range. Reliable valuation of Quandela would require either: (1) expansion of the comparable set through private market data on Series B quantum hardware or software companies with disclosed metrics; (2) application of alternative methods such as discounted cash flow analysis using sector-specific assumptions; or (3) direct reference to precedent transaction data in quantum computing. The primary uncertainty is the thinness of the Series B quantum computing market, which limits the evidentiary basis for peer-based or traded company multiples.
